_comment: Expected ANSWERS (not just rule numbers) for the sample questions. Values were read by hand from the rule text in data/raw/bhumi_vikas_rules.jsonl (page numbers are PDF pages of the English PDF). Reviewer: please confirm; every value below is checked by tests/unit/test_direct_answer.py and scripts/evaluate_rag.py. 'must_contain' strings are looked up in the answer text; 'quote_contains' in the verbatim rule quotes attached to the answer; an empty 'rules' list means the rules do not answer and the tool must say so.

cases.q: My house faces a 10 m wide street and will be 9 m tall. How much open space do I leave at the front?
quote_contains: More than 9.0 meters and up to 12 meters

quote_contains: Minimum size of the plot shall be 0.40 hectare
